name: backend-service
title: Backend Service Change
description: Backend workflow for API, data, and automation changes with explicit contracts, tests, and review gates.

planner.description: Defines behavior, contracts, data ownership, and rollout risk.

executor.description: Implements the backend change and focused tests.

reviewer.description: Reviews contracts, failure modes, test coverage, and operational risk.

steps.task: Analyze the backend request. Output JSON with behavior, API or CLI contract, persistence model, authorization boundaries, acceptance criteria, and stop conditions.
Inspect current modules, command paths, data files, locking rules, and tests. Output JSON with integration points, invariants, and test plan.
Break the work into implementation tasks with expected files, migration needs, verification commands, and rollback notes.
Implement the backend change with narrow scope. Preserve existing data contracts and add or update focused tests.
Run syntax, unit, integration, and data-contract checks. Fix failing checks and output structured results with commands, pass/fail status, and known gaps.
Review implementation, error handling, data safety, and test coverage. Reply PASS or blockers only.
